items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Rene had him send an arrangement to me after then and we had one that as time changed that never did get old

ctx.x: So I said all right, and West goes back again. So I said, try when you come back this time to get Rene to come. So his mother--Rene got it in his head to come, and his mother called Spurgeon in; what kind of fellow is this Ernie Fields, and this and that, because Rene has just about made up his mind that he's going to go when you leave, he's going to go on back to Tulsa with you to join this band. So Spurgeon said he's a fine fellow and nice and clean cut and whatever he says he's going to get, he's going to get.…
go because I'm afraid for him, he's about ready to kill somebody.
